originalTitle: S&P 500, Nasdaq End Lower As AI Jitters Resurface With Nvidia’s Governance Issues And Talks Of Fresh Import Tariffs — NVDA, DELL, TSLA, TGTX In Focus
summary: The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to roll out new tariffs targeting China and dozens of trading partners.
content: The S&P 500 fell about 0.5%, the Nasdaq 100 dropped 2%, and the Dow Jones index rose 0.9% on Tuesday.U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer may release results as soon as Tuesday from a months-long subsidy inquiry covering China, the European Union and 14 other countries.Dell Technologies reported a record Q3 revenue and hiked its full-year FY27 revenue target.The S&P 500 and Nasdaq dropped on Tuesday as optimism around Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO in the previous session was quick to fizzle out as investor attention moved to the possibility of fresh import tariffs by President Trump. The S&P 500 fell about 0.5%, the Nasdaq 100 dropped 2%, and the Dow Jones index rose 0.9% on Tuesday. The Russell 2000, which tracks small-cap stocks, ended 0.6% higher. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) fell about 0.6%, and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) slipped 0.7%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) rose 2.2% on Tuesday. Meanwhile, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF fell between 7.3% and 16%, with Nvidia (NVDA) leading the charts across the board.Retail sentiment on Stocktwits was ‘neutral’ on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY), ‘extremely bullish’ on the Invesco QQQ (QQQ) and ‘bearish’ on the SPDR Dow Jones ETF (DIA).US Market DriversIndexMoveCloseDow Jones Industrial Average0.9%49,595.31 S&P 500-0.5%7,201.09 Nasdaq 100-2%26,214.17 The Trump administration is reportedly moving toward imposing higher import duties on China and dozens of other trading partners that Washington contends are placing American manufacturers at a disadvantage.U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer is expected to publish findings from an inquiry that lasted several months as early as Tuesday, the Wall Street Journal reported. The inquiry takes a deep dive into industrial subsidies across China, the 27-nation European Union and 14 additional countries, though sources cautioned the timeline remains subject to change. “I think we’re still going to see increased volatility in the market because there’s just so many unknowns,” the head of investment decision research at the firm told CNBC, SimCorp’s Diana Baechle told CNBC. Meanwhile, U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche on Tuesday pushed back against suggestions that Nvidia or Huang is under criminal investigation, while refusing to provide any further details related to the chipmaker. Alternatively, Dell Technologies (DELL) on Tuesday rose about 2% after-hours after its third-quarter sales beat expectations and as the AI server maker lifted its FY27 annual outlook for the third time this year. Key Trending StocksRBC Capital Markets analyst Ken Herbert said on Tuesday that he expects a deal announcement between EV giant Tesla Inc. and rocket company SpaceX by early 2027, earlier than it previously expected. A majority of regional Federal Reserve bank boards favored lifting discount rates ahead of the central bank's late-October policy decision, according to meeting minutes released Tuesday. Tesla (TSLA) received a bullish endorsement from Seaport Global Securities on Tuesday, with the firm stating that the rapidly expanding robotaxi operations could become a multibillion-dollar business by the end of next year. Planet Labs PBC (PL) announced on Tuesday that it has expanded its contract with an unnamed European defense and intelligence customer, building on a seven-figure, one-year agreement signed in June 2026. Shares of TG Therapeutics (TGTX) rose on Tuesday, hitting a fresh all-time high, after the company said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) had accepted its application seeking approval for a single-infusion starting regimen of its drug Briumvi. chineseTitle: 由于 Nvidia 的治理问题和新进口关税谈判重新浮现 AI 紧张情绪，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数收低 - NVDA、戴尔、TSLA、TGTX 成为焦点
chineseSummary: 据报道，特朗普政府正准备对中国和数十个贸易伙伴征收新关税。
chineseContent: 周二标普500指数下跌约0.5%，纳斯达克100指数下跌2%，道琼斯指数上涨0.9%。贸易代表杰米森·格里尔(Jamieson Greer)可能最早在周二公布为期数月的补贴调查结果，涵盖中国、欧盟和其他14个国家。戴尔科技公布第三季度营收创历史新高，并上调了2027财年全年营收目标。标普500指数和纳斯达克指数周二下跌，因为前一交易日围绕黄仁勋复任英伟达首席执行官的乐观情绪很快就消失了，因为投资者的注意力转向了新进口关税的可能性。特朗普总统。周二标普500指数下跌约0.5%，纳斯达克100指数下跌2%，道琼斯指数上涨0.9%。追踪小盘股的罗素 2000 指数收盘上涨 0.6%。 SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) 下跌约 0.6%，SPDR 道琼斯工业平均指数 ETF (DIA) 下跌 0.7%。与此同时，追踪 Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) 的纳斯达克 100 指数周二上涨 2.2%。与此同时，VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) 和 iShares Semiconductor ETF 下跌 7.3% 至 16% 之间，Nvidia (NVDA) 全线领先。 Stocktwits 的零售情绪对 SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) 为“中性”，对 Invesco QQQ (QQQ) 为“极度看涨”，对 SPDR Dow Jones ETF 为“看跌” (DIA).美国市场驱动指数移动收盘道琼斯工业平均指数0.9%49,595.31 标准普尔 500-0.5%7,201.09 纳斯达克 100-2%26,214.17 据报道，特朗普政府正准备对中国和其他数十个贸易伙伴征收更高的进口关税，华盛顿认为这些关税使美国制造商处于不利地位。据《华尔街日报》报道，贸易代表杰米森·格里尔预计最早将于周二公布持续数月的调查结果。查询
